Test Case Name: Test case to verify motor  functionality of the Non-Driver PCB
Pre Action:
1.Power Supply - ON
2.Connect the Trace32 hardware to the PC with  target board.
3. Connect Actuator between DRV_OUT_A and DRV_OUT_B motor driver terminals.
4.Run SmartBuApp.bat to open GUI Panel
5.Go to Section Setting
6.Click on Brouse option to select elf  > To Falsh elf
7.Select Variant - Non NFC Version
8.Click on Connect Trace32 and wait for connection
9.Click on Start Code (Go) and  verify Debugger Running
Test Steps:
1.Select Tab > Motor Tab
2.Set Decouple/Couple
3.Click on Run Symbol
(Read voltage betweeen   TP414 (AI_MOTOR_DIAG) and GND )
Expected Result:
MotorVoltage = Greater than 0 mV.
MotorCurrentValue = Greater than 0 mA.
MotorLoadError = 0.
